show.description: The Billionaire’s Divorced Granddaughter is a gripping revenge-romance about betrayal, identity, and power. Namit Jain, left for dead in a plane crash and abandoned by his wife Akansha, rises from humiliation to reclaim his true legacy as the heir of the Jain Empire. As love turns to vengeance and secrets unravel, the battle between the Bansals and the Jains explodes into a storm of wealth, pride, and shattered hearts.
